summary: School district expresses concern about preserving E-Rate funding to maintain access to technology and educational resources for students and staff.

claims.argument: Without E-Rate funding, schools would have to raise tuition or curtail technology access
claims.evidence_quote: Without this funding, we would have to raise the tuition burden on families who normally could not afford it. We would have to curtail access to educational technology. Lastly, administrators who are already stretched thin would be asked to manage technology more instead of focusing on students.
